description: Straight wall from x = 0 to x = wall_length with window (and an optional door) openings cut by a boolean, filled with this kit's window_frame and door_frame outputs. The openings are spread in equal bays; the door takes the middle bay. Modular: segments placed end to end line up. Pivot at the start of the wall, on the ground, centred in thickness (+Z = outside). Pieces: wall (plaster) plus the frames' pieces. Every piece is closed (the wall is one watertight solid).

window_width.desc: window opening width (m), clamped to fit the bay

window_height.desc: window opening height (m), clamped to fit under the top

sill_height.desc: height of the window openings above the ground (m)

door.desc: add a 1.0 × 2.1 m door in the middle bay

frames.desc: fill the openings with window_frame / door_frame

openings.note: cutter boxes (group cut, with scale) and frame anchors at the bottom centre of each opening (groups win_at, door_at)

params.code: if (s@name !== 'wall') return; const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (m) @Cd = m.baseColor;
